description: Retrieves a list of Stripe subscriptions, optionally filtered by various criteria such as customer, price, status, collection method, and date ranges, with support for pagination.

automatic_tax.description: Filter subscriptions by automatic tax settings, e.g., {'enabled': True}.
automatic_tax.title: Automatic Tax

collection_method.description: Filter subscriptions by collection method: 'charge_automatically' or 'send_invoice'.
collection_method.title: Collection Method

created.description: Filter subscriptions by creation date using comparison keys (e.g., 'gte', 'lt') and Unix timestamp values.
created.title: Created

current_period_end.description: Filter subscriptions by the end date of the current billing period, using comparison keys (e.g., 'gt', 'gte') and Unix timestamp values.
current_period_end.title: Current Period End

current_period_start.description: Filter subscriptions by the start date of the current billing period, using comparison keys (e.g., 'lt', 'lte') and Unix timestamp values.
current_period_start.title: Current Period Start

customer.description: ID of the customer whose subscriptions will be retrieved.
customer.title: Customer

ending_before.description: Cursor for paginating backwards; provide the ID of the subscription that should end the list.
ending_before.title: Ending Before

limit.description: Limit on the number of subscription objects to return (1-100). Default is 10.
limit.title: Limit

price.description: ID of the recurring price to filter subscriptions by.
price.title: Price

starting_after.description: Cursor for paginating forwards; provide the ID of the subscription that should start the list.
starting_after.title: Starting After

status.description: Filter subscriptions by status (e.g., 'active', 'all', 'canceled'). Defaults to non-canceled statuses if unspecified.
status.title: Status

test_clock.description: Filter subscriptions by a specific test clock ID (only applicable in test mode).
test_clock.title: Test Clock

name: list_subscriptions

disabledReason.description: The reason automatic tax is disabled if enabled is false.
disabledReason.title: Disabled Reason

enabled.description: Whether Stripe automatically computes tax on this subscription.
enabled.title: Enabled

liability.description: The account that's liable for tax.
liability.title: Liability

account.description: The connected account being referenced when type is account.
account.title: Account

type.description: Type of the account referenced. Either 'account' or 'self'.
type.title: Type

dayOfMonth.description: The day of the month for the billing cycle anchor.
dayOfMonth.title: Day Of Month

hour.description: The hour of the day for the billing cycle anchor.
hour.title: Hour

minute.description: The minute of the hour for the billing cycle anchor.
minute.title: Minute

month.description: The month to start full cycle billing periods.
month.title: Month

second.description: The second of the minute for the billing cycle anchor.
second.title: Second

type.description: The billing mode type. Either 'classic' or 'flexible'.
type.title: Type

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the current billing mode was adopted.
updatedAt.title: Updated At

prorationDiscounts.description: How proration discounts are handled. Either 'included' or 'itemized'.
prorationDiscounts.title: Proration Discounts

amountGte.description: Monetary threshold that triggers the subscription to advance to a new billing period.
amountGte.title: Amount Gte

resetBillingCycleAnchor.description: Indicates if the billing_cycle_anchor should be reset when a threshold is reached.
resetBillingCycleAnchor.title: Reset Billing Cycle Anchor

feedback.description: Additional feedback from the customer about why they canceled.
feedback.title: Feedback

reason.description: The reason for cancellation. One of: cancellation_requested, payment_disputed, or payment_failed.
reason.title: Reason

account.description: The connected account being referenced when type is account.
account.title: Account

type.description: Type of the account referenced. Either 'account' or 'self'.
type.title: Type

accountTaxIds.description: The account tax IDs associated with the subscription.
accountTaxIds.title: Account Tax Ids

issuer.description: The connected account that issues the invoice.
issuer.title: Issuer

hasMore.description: Whether there are more items available beyond this page of results.
hasMore.title: Has More

object.description: String representing the object's type. Always 'list' for list operations.
object.title: Object

url.description: The URL path for the subscriptions list endpoint (/v1/subscriptions).
url.title: Url

behavior.description: The payment collection behavior for this subscription while paused. One of keep_as_draft, mark_uncollectible, or void.
behavior.title: Behavior

resumesAt.description: The time after which the subscription will resume. Timestamp in Unix seconds format.
resumesAt.title: Resumes At

acssDebit.description: ACSS debit specific payment method options.
acssDebit.title: Acss Debit

customerBalance.description: Customer balance specific payment method options.
customerBalance.title: Customer Balance

sepaDebit.description: SEPA debit specific payment method options.
sepaDebit.title: Sepa Debit

usBankAccount.description: US bank account specific payment method options.
usBankAccount.title: Us Bank Account

paymentMethodOptions.description: Payment-method-specific configuration to provide to invoices created by the subscription.
paymentMethodOptions.title: Payment Method Options

paymentMethodTypes.description: The list of payment method types to provide to every invoice created by the subscription.
paymentMethodTypes.title: Payment Method Types

saveDefaultPaymentMethod.description: Either off or on_subscription. With on_subscription Stripe updates subscription.default_payment_method when a subscription payment succeeds.
saveDefaultPaymentMethod.title: Save Default Payment Method

interval.description: Specifies invoicing frequency. Either day, week, month or year.
interval.title: Interval

intervalCount.description: The number of intervals between invoices. For example, interval=month and interval_count=3 bills every 3 months. Maximum of one year interval allowed (1 year, 12 months, or 52 weeks).
intervalCount.title: Interval Count

billingCycleAnchor.description: If the update is applied, determines the date of the first full invoice, and, for plans with month or year intervals, the day of the month for subsequent invoices.
billingCycleAnchor.title: Billing Cycle Anchor

expiresAt.description: The point after which the changes reflected by this update will be discarded and no longer applied.
expiresAt.title: Expires At

subscriptionItems.description: List of subscription items that will be updated.
subscriptionItems.title: Subscription Items

trialEnd.description: Unix timestamp representing the end of the trial period the customer will get before being charged for the first time, if the update is applied.
trialEnd.title: Trial End

trialFromPlan.description: Indicates if a plan's trial_period_days should be applied to the subscription. Setting trial_end per subscription is preferred.
trialFromPlan.title: Trial From Plan

active.description: Whether the price can be used for new purchases.
active.title: Active

billingScheme.description: Describes how to compute the price per period. Either per_unit or tiered.
billingScheme.title: Billing Scheme

created.description: Time at which the price was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
created.title: Created

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase.
currency.title: Currency

livemode.description: Has the value true if the object exists in live mode or the value false if the object exists in test mode.
livemode.title: Livemode

lookupKey.description: A lookup key used to retrieve prices dynamically from a static string.
lookupKey.title: Lookup Key

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object.
metadata.title: Metadata

nickname.description: A brief description of the price, hidden from customers.
nickname.title: Nickname

object.description: String representing the object's type. Always 'price'.
object.title: Object

product.description: The ID of the product this price is associated with.
product.title: Product

recurring.description: The recurring components of a price such as interval and usage_type.
recurring.title: Recurring

taxBehavior.description: Specifies whether the price is considered inclusive of taxes or exclusive of taxes. One of inclusive, exclusive, or unspecified.
taxBehavior.title: Tax Behavior

tiers.description: Each element represents a pricing tier. This parameter requires billing_scheme to be set to tiered.
tiers.title: Tiers

tiersMode.description: Defines if the tiering price should be graduated or volume based. Either graduated or volume.
tiersMode.title: Tiers Mode

transformQuantity.description: Apply a transformation to the reported usage or set quantity before computing the amount billed.
transformQuantity.title: Transform Quantity

type.description: One of one_time or recurring depending on whether the price is for a one-time purchase or a recurring (subscription) purchase.
type.title: Type

unitAmount.description: The unit amount in cents to be charged, represented as a whole integer if possible.
unitAmount.title: Unit Amount

unitAmountDecimal.description: The unit amount in cents to be charged, represented as a decimal string with at most 12 decimal places.
unitAmountDecimal.title: Unit Amount Decimal

interval.description: Specifies billing frequency. Either day, week, month or year.
interval.title: Interval

intervalCount.description: The number of intervals (specified in the interval attribute) between subscription billings.
intervalCount.title: Interval Count

meter.description: The meter tracking the usage of a metered price.
meter.title: Meter

trialPeriodDays.description: Default number of trial days when subscribing a customer to this price using trial_from_plan=true.
trialPeriodDays.title: Trial Period Days

usageType.description: Configures how the quantity per period should be determined. Either metered or licensed.
usageType.title: Usage Type

unitAmount.description: Per unit price for units relevant to the tier.
unitAmount.title: Unit Amount

upTo.description: Up to and including this quantity will be contained in the tier.
upTo.title: Up To

round.description: After division, either round the result up or down. One of: up or down.
round.title: Round

defaultPaymentMethod.description: ID of the default payment method for the subscription. It must belong to the customer associated with the subscription.
defaultPaymentMethod.title: Default Payment Method

trialEnd.description: If the subscription has a trial, the end of that trial. Timestamp in Unix seconds format.
trialEnd.title: Trial End

endedAt.description: If the subscription has ended, the date the subscription ended. Timestamp in Unix seconds format.
endedAt.title: Ended At

application.description: ID of the Connect Application that created the subscription.
application.title: Application

plan.description: The plan the customer is subscribed to (legacy field).
plan.title: Plan

automaticTax.description: Automatic tax settings for this subscription.
automaticTax.title: Automatic Tax

paymentSettings.description: Payment settings to pass to invoices created by the subscription.
paymentSettings.title: Payment Settings

items.description: List of subscription items, each with an attached price.
items.title: Items

nextPendingInvoiceItemInvoice.description: Specifies the approximate timestamp on which any pending invoice items will be billed according to the schedule provided at pending_invoice_item_interval. Timestamp in Unix seconds format.
nextPendingInvoiceItemInvoice.title: Next Pending Invoice Item Invoice

description.description: An arbitrary string attached to the subscription. Often useful for displaying to users. Maximum of 500 characters.
description.title: Description

billingCycleAnchorConfig.description: The fixed values used to calculate the billing_cycle_anchor.
billingCycleAnchorConfig.title: Billing Cycle Anchor Config

presentmentDetails.description: Additional details about how the subscription should be presented.
presentmentDetails.title: Presentment Details

created.description: Time at which the subscription was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
created.title: Created

collectionMethod.description: Either charge_automatically or send_invoice. When charging automatically, Stripe will attempt to pay this subscription at the end of the cycle using the default source attached to the customer. When sending an invoice, Stripe will email your customer an invoice with payment instructions and mark the subscription as active.
collectionMethod.title: Collection Method

status.description: Possible values are incomplete, incomplete_expired, trialing, active, past_due, canceled, unpaid, or paused.
status.title: Status

discounts.description: The discounts applied to the subscription. Subscription item discounts are applied before subscription discounts. Use expand[]=discounts to expand each discount.
discounts.title: Discounts

startDate.description: Date when the subscription was first created. The date might differ from the created date due to backdating. Timestamp in Unix seconds format.
startDate.title: Start Date

pendingSetupIntent.description: You can use this SetupIntent to collect user authentication when creating a subscription without immediate payment or updating a subscription's payment method, allowing you to optimize for off-session payments.
pendingSetupIntent.title: Pending Setup Intent

latestInvoice.description: The most recent invoice this subscription has generated.
latestInvoice.title: Latest Invoice

pendingInvoiceItemInterval.description: Specifies an interval for how often to bill for any pending invoice items. It is analogous to calling Create an invoice for the given subscription at the specified interval.
pendingInvoiceItemInterval.title: Pending Invoice Item Interval

billingThresholds.description: Define thresholds at which an invoice will be sent, and the subscription advanced to a new billing period.
billingThresholds.title: Billing Thresholds

customer.description: ID of the customer who owns the subscription.
customer.title: Customer

defaultSource.description: ID of the default payment source for the subscription. It must belong to the customer associated with the subscription and be in a chargeable state.
defaultSource.title: Default Source

pauseCollection.description: If specified, payment collection for this subscription will be paused.
pauseCollection.title: Pause Collection

customerAccount.description: ID of the customer account associated with this subscription.
customerAccount.title: Customer Account

quantity.description: The quantity of the plan to which the customer is subscribed.
quantity.title: Quantity

cancelAt.description: A date in the future at which the subscription will automatically get canceled. Timestamp in Unix seconds format.
cancelAt.title: Cancel At

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.
metadata.title: Metadata

daysUntilDue.description: Number of days a customer has to pay invoices generated by this subscription. Valid only for subscriptions where collection_method is set to send_invoice.
daysUntilDue.title: Days Until Due

canceledAt.description: If the subscription has been canceled, the date of that cancellation. Timestamp in Unix seconds format.
canceledAt.title: Canceled At

cancellationDetails.description: Details about why this subscription was cancelled.
cancellationDetails.title: Cancellation Details

livemode.description: Has the value true if the object exists in live mode or the value false if the object exists in test mode.
livemode.title: Livemode

pendingUpdate.description: If specified, pending updates that will be applied to the subscription once the latest_invoice has been paid.
pendingUpdate.title: Pending Update

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase.
currency.title: Currency

onBehalfOf.description: The account (if any) the charge was made on behalf of for charges associated with this subscription.
onBehalfOf.title: On Behalf Of

transferData.description: The account (if any) the subscription's payments will be attributed to for tax reporting, and where funds from each payment will be transferred to for each of the subscription's invoices.
transferData.title: Transfer Data

applicationFeePercent.description: A non-negative decimal between 0 and 100, with at most two decimal places, representing the percentage of the subscription invoice total that will be transferred to the application owner's Stripe account.
applicationFeePercent.title: Application Fee Percent

defaultTaxRates.description: The tax rates that will apply to any subscription item that does not have tax_rates set.
defaultTaxRates.title: Default Tax Rates

schedule.description: The schedule attached to the subscription.
schedule.title: Schedule

cancelAtPeriodEnd.description: If the subscription has been canceled with the at_period_end flag set to true, this field will be true. Otherwise, it will be false.
cancelAtPeriodEnd.title: Cancel At Period End

object.description: String representing the object's type. Always 'subscription'.
object.title: Object

testClock.description: ID of the test clock this subscription belongs to.
testClock.title: Test Clock

billingCycleAnchor.description: Determines the date of the first full invoice, and, for plans with month or year intervals, the day of the month for subsequent invoices. The timestamp is in Unix seconds format.
billingCycleAnchor.title: Billing Cycle Anchor

billingMode.description: Controls how prorations and invoices for subscriptions are calculated.
billingMode.title: Billing Mode

trialStart.description: If the subscription has a trial, the beginning of that trial. Timestamp in Unix seconds format.
trialStart.title: Trial Start

billingThresholds.description: Define thresholds at which an invoice will be sent for this specific item.
billingThresholds.title: Billing Thresholds

created.description: Time at which the subscription item was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
created.title: Created

currentPeriodEnd.description: End of the current period for which this subscription item is billed.
currentPeriodEnd.title: Current Period End

currentPeriodStart.description: Start of the current period for which this subscription item is billed.
currentPeriodStart.title: Current Period Start

discounts.description: The discounts applied to the subscription item. Subscription item discounts are applied before subscription discounts.
discounts.title: Discounts

id.description: Unique identifier for the subscription item.
id.title: Id

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object.
metadata.title: Metadata

object.description: String representing the object's type. Always 'subscription_item'.
object.title: Object

plan.description: The plan the customer is subscribed to (legacy field).
plan.title: Plan

price.description: The price the customer is subscribed to.
price.title: Price

quantity.description: The quantity of the plan to which the customer should be subscribed.
quantity.title: Quantity

subscription.description: The subscription this subscription_item belongs to.
subscription.title: Subscription

taxRates.description: The tax rates which apply to this subscription_item. When set, the default_tax_rates on the subscription do not apply to this subscription_item.
taxRates.title: Tax Rates

usageGte.description: Usage threshold that triggers the subscription to create an invoice.
usageGte.title: Usage Gte

hasMore.description: Whether there are more items available beyond this page.
hasMore.title: Has More

object.description: String representing the object's type. Always 'list' for subscription items.
object.title: Object

totalCount.description: The total number of items available.
totalCount.title: Total Count

url.description: The URL where this list can be accessed.
url.title: Url

active.description: Defaults to true. When set to false, this tax rate cannot be used with new applications or Checkout Sessions.
active.title: Active

created.description: Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
created.title: Created

description.description: An arbitrary string attached to the tax rate for your internal use only. It will not be visible to your customers.
description.title: Description

displayName.description: The display name of the tax rate, which will appear on your customer's invoice.
displayName.title: Display Name

effectivePercentage.description: Actual tax rate percentage reflecting calculations based on product taxability.
effectivePercentage.title: Effective Percentage

flatAmount.description: The flat tax amount when rate_type is flat_amount.
flatAmount.title: Flat Amount

id.description: Unique identifier for the tax rate.
id.title: Id

inclusive.description: This specifies if the tax rate is inclusive or exclusive.
inclusive.title: Inclusive

jurisdiction.description: The jurisdiction for the tax rate. You can use this label field for tax reporting purposes.
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

jurisdictionLevel.description: The level of the jurisdiction that imposes this tax rate. One of: city, country, county, district, multiple, or state.
jurisdictionLevel.title: Jurisdiction Level

livemode.description: Has the value true if the object exists in live mode or the value false if the object exists in test mode.
livemode.title: Livemode

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object.
metadata.title: Metadata

object.description: String representing the object's type. Always 'tax_rate'.
object.title: Object

percentage.description: This represents the tax rate percent out of 100.
percentage.title: Percentage

rateType.description: Type of tax rate. One of: flat_amount or percentage.
rateType.title: Rate Type

state.description: ISO 3166-2 subdivision code, without country prefix.
state.title: State

taxType.description: The high-level tax type, such as vat or sales_tax.
taxType.title: Tax Type

amount.description: The flat tax amount in cents.
amount.title: Amount

amountPercent.description: A non-negative decimal between 0 and 100, with at most two decimal places, representing the percentage of the subscription invoice total that will be transferred to the destination account.

destination.description: The account where funds from the payment will be transferred to upon payment success.
